signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Primary brand accent — links, active nav indicators, icon highlights, the inner play-button of the product mockup. Saturated enough to be the one color users remember, restrained enough to never compete with copy

action-blue.$description: Action Blue — Filled CTA buttons (Upgrade to Cap Pro), focus rings, and the strongest interactive state. One shade deeper than Signal Blue to give pressed actions a subtle weight shift

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Headings, body text, the dark CTA button fill (Download for free). Off-black rather than pure #000 to avoid harsh edges on white

carbon.$description: Carbon — Pure black reserved for the highest-emphasis text and icon fills where maximum contrast is required

paper.$description: Paper — Page and card canvas — the dominant surface across the entire site. Near-white, not pure white, to soften the reading field

mist.$description: Mist — Secondary surface for subtle differentiation — the segmented control track, inset highlights, and muted button backgrounds

fog.$description: Fog — Hairline borders on cards, buttons, and the nav bar. The structural divider of the design system

ash.$description: Ash — Borders and dividers at the lowest visual layer; also appears as a subtle backdrop wash behind the footer card

steel.$description: Steel — Mid-gray for secondary icon strokes and placeholder-like elements that should recede but remain visible

graphite.$description: Graphite — Muted captions, helper text, and de-emphasized UI labels.

slate.$description: Slate — Button text on light surfaces, tertiary metadata text. One step deeper than Graphite for buttons that need a touch more presence

outlined-indigo.$description: Outlined Indigo — Violet accent for outlined action borders, linked labels, and lightweight interactive emphasis.

spark-violet.$description: Spark Violet — Violet text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases

spark-violet-soft.$description: Spark Violet Soft — Lighter violet companion to Spark Violet for secondary decorative strokes and gradient endpoints

ember.$description: Ember — Orange text accent for links, tags, and emphasized short phrases.

sky.$description: Sky — Icon stroke variant within the mode selector — the paired companion to Ember for the three-mode icon set

ice.$description: Ice — Tinted blue surface wash — a barely-perceptible cool tint used for soft highlight backgrounds and the outer glow ring on the product mockup play button

cyan-glow.$description: Cyan Glow — Bright cyan accent for the glow/shadow halo behind the play button overlay in the product mockup

alert-red.$description: Alert Red — Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

macos-red.$description: macOS Red — Red wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

macos-yellow.$description: macOS Yellow — Yellow wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

macos-green.$description: macOS Green — Green wash for highlight backgrounds, decorative bands, and soft emphasis behind content. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

defaultfont.$description: defaultFont — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

cap-sans-custom-geometric-sans-similar-t.$value: Cap Sans (custom geometric sans, similar to General Sans or Inter Display)
cap-sans-custom-geometric-sans-similar-t.$description: Single-family system. Weight 700 at 52–60px for hero and section display headings — tight tracking, almost no letter-spacing, confident and unornamented. Weight 500 at 18–20px for subheadings and feature titles. Weight 400 at 14–16px for body and descriptions. Weight 500 at 11–12px for uppercase eyebrow labels with +0.2em tracking creates the only typographic accent in the system.

ui-monospace-sfmono-regular-menlo-consol.$description: Used sparingly for micro-labels and version numbers in the product mockup. Not part of the marketing surface.
